answer_1.quote: We propose to tackle the task of VCG by leveraging our Knowledge Enhanced Multimodal BART (KM-BART), which is a Transformer-based model ... generate texts based on visual and textual inputs.
answer_1.outputs: commonsense inference sentences describing events before, after, and intents of characters

answer_2.quote: We use three automatic evaluation metrics, including BLEU-2, METEOR, and CIDER. Following, we also report Unique as the number of inference sentences unique in generated sentences ... and Novel as the number of generated sentences not in the training data.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation ... We hire three workers from Amazon Mechanical Turk to evaluate each inference. For the same example, we use our KM-BART and the baseline model to generate an inference ... then the workers choose the more reasonable inference from the two generated inferences.
answer_4.guideline: Workers compare the inference from KM-BART and the baseline for each task type (before, after, intent) and select the more reasonable one.
